name: Hierarchical Data Distribution with Error-Guided Bucketization
definition: A data distribution scheme for parallel volume rendering that partitions the wavelet hierarchy among processors to minimize dependency and ensure load balancing. It uses an 'Every-K' storage strategy to eliminate inter-processor communication dependencies during reconstruction and a space-filling curve with error-guided bucketization to balance workload.
summary: Hierarchical Data Distribution with Error-Guided Bucketization is a parallel volume rendering scheme that partitions wavelet trees into independent units and balances workloads by distributing nodes with similar reconstruction errors across different processors.
